candidates.label: A — Linked Crest
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished NEW TOP-LEFT PLAYER STATUS HUD showcase for the pixel-action RPG Battle of Gods. Image1 is the reported in-game crop: preserve its village/timber/stone pixel-game setting and King identity, but REPLACE its rejected top-left HUD completely. Image2 provides the approved dark steel/cyan/violet RPG visual language only; DO NOT copy its stats or skill rows. This is one candidate preview, not an asset atlas and not three options in one image.
Composition: show a cropped upper-left gameplay area, approximately the same crop/aspect as image1, with the proposed status HUD installed at its top-left at plausible compact game scale. Show the whole HUD without clipping, give it a little safe edge margin and room to read. Faithful illustrated pixel-RPG UI; dark opaque readable wells, disciplined pewter bevels, a FEW substantial cyan/violet details, clear outline separation and clean native-looking text. Avoid dozens of tiny ornaments, sharp spikes, noisy jewelry, generic flat wireframes, mobile glass panels or blurry resized lettering. The King portrait has dark-brown tousled hair, warm skin, complete neck and red scarf, matching image2. The portrait is first on the LEFT; HP extends RIGHT. Deep red is HP; purple is WEAPON-FAMILY MASTERY. These are separate progress tracks. Player level is a small readable badge at the portrait. Mastery rank is distinct from player level.
EXACT game text and illustrative comparison values: portrait badge "Lv 10"; HP "248 / 248"; family mastery label "SWORD MASTERY"; mastery rank "5"; purple mastery progress "340 / 600". Show ONE mastery meter only, visibly about57% full, with its numbers inside the meter. Show one small coin icon plus "3,218" below the status group if space allows. Mastery means learning this weapon family, NOT the item name or a damage stat.
STRICT EXCLUSIONS: no ATK, DEF or AS stat chips, no attack/defense/speed tiles, no standalone weapon-name strip, no "King's Sword", no King name header, no second empty gauge, no duplicate progress rail, no bottom skill UI, no Bag/settings, no invented quests, no other avatars or NPC labels overlapping the HUD. All panels, bars and badges complete and legible. No extra text except the design label below and the exact UI values. The village stays behind the HUD; all values here are visual review examples, not claims of real progression.
Candidate A — LINKED CREST. Design target: about240x66 logical pixels. One compact connected angular composition: a56px octagonal King portrait on the left; an elegant deep-red HP rail attached to its upper-right; the SWORD MASTERY label, rank5 and a purple meter directly beneath HP on the right. Make those TWO bars feel like one authored silhouette attached to the portrait, with coherent thickness and generous internal text padding. NO additional third bottom row. Slight beveled/chamfered ends, just two cold-cyan facets and one small purple mastery accent. A confident tiny Lv10 badge sits at the lower-right of the portrait without covering its scarf. Keep the right-hand plate shorter and tidier than image1. Put the visible label "A · LINKED CREST" in a quiet corner of the showcase OUTSIDE the actual HUD.
